title: 控制台每次打开只请求一次语言列表
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX11yNi4DyGhuzqBpV

Filing gate: ① regression found by a cloud gate. Source: cloud `console-boots` call budget (cloud#2914) on the pin round objectstack-ai/cloud#4964 (pin `4c4a677721d3`, merged `b1bdf4b4`); root cause in the os-dev report objectstack-ai/cloud#4964 comment 7139458310. Card filed after the fact for PR #37052, which was opened on the seat's order.

Grading: area:cloud (it blocks the next cloud pin round's `console-boots`, maintainer rule 2026-11-24 03:50Z) · Bug · p2 · evidence: measured (local stacks, old vs new pin, same harness).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：控制台每打开一个页面，会把「语言列表」请求发两遍（#36916 新加的流程标签回退逻辑又单独请求了一次）。
- 影响：功能正常，只是每次打开多一次请求；云端的启动请求预算因此超标。
- 修法：同一次页面加载里，语言列表只读一次，两处共用结果。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

`ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` `fetchDeclaredChain` (objectstack#36916, `129e637a4e8`) requests `/api/v1/i18n/locales` beside `loadLocales.ts`'s own read of the same URL. Share one read per page load (a failed read is not cached, so a later caller retries).

## Acceptance

- One `i18n/locales` request per signed-in open (test + ablation red).
- Measured with cloud's `verify-console-pin.mjs` on the `4c4a677` backend: 0 duplicate URLs on page/pricing and page/welcome.
- Not in scope: the declared-fallback bundle read (`i18n/translations/<fallback>`), which is the feature as designed. Its budget line is the cloud seat's call on cloud#2914.
